name: Minibot World
summary:
Minibot World is a free online multiplayer game where players explore a shared world as customizable cats. Players can decorate and visit factories, fish and sail at Moonlight Harbour, take part in cooperative mining expeditions, and play drawing and guessing games together.

The Raidfront world adds cooperative combat against NPC enemies, with weapons, companion drones, drivable vehicles and a pilotable walker. Persistent progression and the Tuna economy are connected to the game’s Discord community.
